question: What consequences follow from the absence or excess of rims in the fire-pit?
premises: Absence of rims leads to sorrow.
Excess of rims leads to destruction of wealth.
The condition of the rims determines the outcome.
inference: Improper formation of the rims produces specific harmful consequences.
plain_english: If it is devoid of rims, there is sorrow; if there is excess, there is destruction of wealth.
